notes: DSADS = Daily and Sports Activities Data Set. Canonical dataset paper (this 2014 Computer Journal article); the dataset was first introduced in Altun, Barshan & Tuncel 2010 (Pattern Recognition, doi:10.1016/j.patcog.2010.04.019). Sensor setup: 5 Xsens MTx units placed on torso/chest, right arm, left arm, right leg, left leg; each unit has tri-axial accelerometer + gyroscope + magnetometer (9 axes/unit => 45 sensor channels total). Sampling rate 25 Hz. 8 subjects (4 female, 4 male, ages 20-30). 19 activities, each performed 5 min per subject. Signals segmented into 5-second windows => 60 segments/subject/activity, 480 segments/activity total, 9120 segments overall. Dataset DOI: 10.24432/C5C59F. Download ZIP ~162.9 MB: https://data.uci.edu/static/public/256/daily+and+sports+activities.zip . PDF (19 pages, ~1.07 MB) obtained from Bilkent University institutional repository author copy.
